questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you that the bridge ahead may be too narrow to safely meet or pass a truck. Slow down and be careful.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows a bicycle crossing or path ahead. Drive carefully because bicycles may cross or ride near traffic in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic signal, red is always at the top and green at the bottom. On a horizontal signal, red is always on the left and green on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction are about to become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Drivers can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When the left arm is extended straight out to the left, it means the driver plans to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a low ground railroad crossing. The railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle, and the undercarriage of low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Drivers can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When the left arm is extended straight out to the left, it means the driver plans to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Slow down and watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is displaying a red light.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is displaying a green light.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights display colors from bottom to top in this order: green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a center lane reserved only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use it for passing or going straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of multiple curves ahead on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
Operators may turn left or continue straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that from this lane, you must either turn right or go straight. You cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you that a divided highway is ahead. Diamond-shaped warning signs have black symbols on a yellow background.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway begins ahead with two one-way roads separated by a median. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will make a sharp right turn followed by a sharp left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns you of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid brake damage or crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: All eight-sided signs are stop signs. Come to a complete stop and look for pedestrians and cars crossing. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns you that wet roads are slippery. Drive carefully in wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings alerts you to expect bicycles crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the recommended maximum speed for an expressway exit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When the left arm is bent upward at the elbow, it signals a right turn or lane change to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond-shaped sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns of a sharp turn ahead. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black sign warns that a lane is ending. Be ready to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a Y intersection ahead. Choose to go either right or left.
